title: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (with…
description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.6.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'metavalue' parameter when used with the 'metakeyinput=cctor_expiration' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages.
